text: The requirement's chain is one card in its preview: controls mapped, allocated to, evidence, findings, risks, remediation, each counted, each record opening its own preview.
No ↗: a requirement has no page of its own. The old page's address opens the Requirements page with that requirement's preview open.
Map control is wired: choose a control (those no requirement maps first); the chain, the register's Controls and the control's own status move.
Link evidence is wired from the preview and the selection bar: the chain lists it, Cite no evidence drops, mapped controls reach Not assessed.
Link evidence is wired: the same action as the requirement's, so the requirement's chain and the Requirements register show it.
A requirement mapped from its own Map control is listed on the control's preview and page too: one source for the mapping.
The five quick views filter the rows (they were words that did nothing), so a link or the launcher can open Needs evidence.
Review evidence takes a real decision; What to revise is required only to send back. Accept moves Pending review 88 to 87, Accepted 227.
Upload needs a file and Add link a URL; the artifact then joins the register first, All 369, pending review, and its preview opens.
The header's Create POA&M item is wired: choose the open issue it answers; the item joins POA&M first (Items 42), as from the issue preview.
Create POA&M item from the selection bar answers every chosen issue in one item.
The header's Create risk is wired: the risk joins the register (Register 41), resting on an issue where one is named.
Create task is wired: the task is listed first and the chips count it (All 15, Open 11); its preview opens.
Add security outcomes opens NIST SP 800-160 Vol. 1's outcomes the gate lacks; chosen ones join its criteria and the card's count.
Add evidence needs a file; the version is cited by REQ-064 and joins the Evidence tab (2), the rail and Activity, pending review.
The CVI card's Plan an assessment gives that planned campaign its first plan; the card then opens its campaign. The header's plans a new one.
Treat 2 critical risks opens Risks with the filter Severity: Critical applied as a removable chip: exactly the 2 risks it counts.
Invite people puts the invitee on the Team card and the Roles count; on the example page it says nothing is kept.
Ask Priya Raghavan records the ask: the card reads Asked on Nov 17 and offers Ask again.
Edit asset opens a dialog for serial number, manufacturer and owner; the asset preview shows what was saved.
The launcher answers questions from the prototype's data (which controls lack evidence: 233, opening Needs evidence); others point to AI agents.
Controls satisfied is N of M alone; the 23 mini bars beside the numbers are gone.
Milestones reached is N of M alone; the 14 bars beside the numbers are gone.
Evidence received is N of M alone; the 12 rings beside the numbers are gone.
8 type size/weight pairs (was 12): avatar initials at 12px instead of 10.4, 11.2 and 8.8px; the bar title at 14px.
8 type pairs (was 9): Needs attention's counts take the card title's weight.
8 type pairs (was 9): the completion card's 176 of 560 controls in the page's 12px grey.
The section flags are ink sentences with a red diamond, not red sentences (3 interfaces since approval, no rationale, Block 1.1).
The severity card says its total once, in its title; the big figure that repeated it is gone.
The selection bar no longer repeats the header's Export: chosen risks offer Assign owner, Request acceptance and Start reassessment.
Accept evidence no longer toasts a success for nothing: it says it isn't wired here and that Evidence's Review saves a decision.
Generate says it isn't wired instead of announcing a run that never lands.
Create configuration says it isn't wired instead of toasting Configuration drafted.
Could fold like the requirement: a queue row's page repeats the record it waits on; the preview and the record's own page suffice.
Could fold: a lifecycle gate's criteria and decision fit its preview on the Schedule; the app gives a gate no page.
Could fold: an ATT&CK technique is reference data with no record of its own; its preview carries everything its page shows.
Could fold: an asset's page holds its facts and scans only; the preview on Inventory carries the same.
Could fold: an interconnection's page repeats its preview; the register's preview could carry its agreement and flows.
Could fold: an AI agent run is a log entry; its page adds nothing to the preview beside the register.
Could fold: a decision belongs to its package version; the Authorization page's preview can carry it.
